result.detail: Systeme.io public API uses per-account API keys. Each customer generates their own key under "Public API keys" in their dashboard and sends it in the X-API-Key header. Docs describe no OAuth, no app review or approval, no marketplace requirement and no install cap. The only numeric limit is 3 API keys per account, plus a shared rate limit. The developer docs say the API key is the only auth option for now. Both pages were read through a fetch subagent, not directly.
result.quote: To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, your only option right now is to attach your API key to the `X-API-Key` header of each request.
